story: A 12-year-old girl with supernatural fire powers, manipulated by a demon trapped in her teddy bear named Scratcher. Annie accidentally burned down her family's cottage in the mountains, killing her mother, father, and older sister while defending them from brigands. A scientist studying the supernatural brought her to the asylum to study her powers, separating her from Scratcher.

gameObjects.name: Cell Door
gameObjects.description: A heavy wooden door with no handle on the inside. It's locked from the outside, designed to keep someone imprisoned.
clues: The door can only be opened from the outside.
Perhaps there's another way out of this room...

actions.result: The door won't budge. It's locked tight from the outside.
The door is solid and old. You notice scratch marks near the bottom, as if someone desperately tried to claw their way out.

gameObjects.name: Old Wooden Desk
gameObjects.description: A weathered wooden desk with multiple drawers. The wood is scarred with small claw marks.
clues: The desk has several drawers that can be opened.
Tiny claw marks cover one side of the desk.
There's a strange draft coming from underneath the desk.

actions.result: You open the drawers and find several old letters written by Annie to her family. They speak of a 'friend' named Scratcher and strange powers she's discovered.
The desk is covered in claw marks. Looking closer, you notice they're too small to be human. Underneath the desk, you spot a metal vent grate.
You can't move the desk - it's bolted to the floor. But you can see underneath it clearly now.

gameObjects.name: Air Vent
gameObjects.description: A metal grate covers an air vent underneath the desk. It looks like it hasn't been opened in years.
clues: The vent is secured with screws.
This vent is large enough for someone small to crawl through.
You notice scratches around the edges, as if someone tried to pry it open many times.

actions.result: The vent is screwed shut. You need something to unscrew it.
Peering through the grate, you can see a key hanging on a hook just on the other side. If only you could reach it...

You use the screwdriver from the janitor's jacket to unscrew the vent. The grate falls away, revealing a dark passage. You crawl through and emerge on the other side, grabbing the cell key from the hook.

gameObjects.name: Charred Wall
gameObjects.description: The wall is blackened and charred, as if exposed to intense heat. Ash covers parts of the surface.
clues: The burn patterns suggest the fire came from inside the room, not outside.
Words are written in ash: 'Scratcher promised to protect us'
The charring is most intense near the bed.

actions.result: You brush away some ash and reveal more writing: 'I didn't mean to hurt them. The fire... it just happened. Scratcher said I had to defend myself.'

gameObjects.name: Metal Bed Frame
gameObjects.description: A small metal bed with a thin, stained mattress. The springs squeak with any movement.
clues: The mattress has a small indentation near the pillow, as if something small slept there regularly.
Claw marks cover the bed frame.
Something is hidden under the mattress.

actions.result: You notice the indentation near the pillow is too small for a child. It's about the size of a teddy bear.
You lift the mattress and find a charred piece of paper - a drawing done by a child. It shows a teddy bear with red eyes and sharp teeth. At the bottom it says: 'My friend Scratcher'.

gameObjects.name: Scratcher (Teddy Bear)
gameObjects.description: A worn teddy bear sitting on a shelf. It has button eyes, but one is missing. Its paws end in unnaturally sharp 'claws' made of metal.
clues: The teddy bear's remaining eye seems to watch you.
The metal claws match the claw marks throughout the room.
A tag on the bear reads: 'Found at midnight altar, forest grove'.
The bear smells faintly of sulfur and ash.

actions.result: This isn't a normal teddy bear. The metal claws are sharp and deliberately crafted. Its stitching forms symbols you don't recognize. This is no child's toy - it's something far more sinister.
As you touch the bear, you feel an unnatural warmth. For a moment, you hear whispers... promises of power... protection... The room suddenly feels colder.

gameObjects.name: Claw Marks
gameObjects.description: Small claw marks scattered throughout the room - on the desk, bed frame, floor, and even the door.
clues: The claw marks are too small and precise to be from an animal.
They're most concentrated around the desk and bed.
The pattern suggests whatever made them moved freely around the room.

actions.result: Examining the claw marks closely, you notice they match the metal claws on Scratcher's paws perfectly. Whatever made these marks wasn't trapped in the teddy bear form - it could move.

gameObjects.name: Burnt Drawing
gameObjects.description: A child's drawing, partially burnt, showing a teddy bear with disturbing features.
clues: The bear in the drawing has red eyes and sharp teeth.
Written at the bottom: 'My friend Scratcher - he helps me'
On the back: 'He showed me the fire. He says I'm special.'

actions.result: This drawing reveals Annie's perception of Scratcher. What she saw as a friend and protector was clearly something demonic. The red eyes and sharp teeth suggest she knew, on some level, what he truly was.

items.name: Annie's Letters
items.description: A collection of letters written by Annie to her family, pleading for help and describing her strange new powers.
content: Letter 1: 'Dear Mother and Father, I miss home so much. I found a friend in the forest - he talks to me. His name is Scratcher. - Annie'
Letter 2: 'Scratcher says I have special gifts. He's teaching me things. Father would be proud. - Annie'
Letter 3: 'The brigands came last night. I was so scared. Scratcher said to defend us. I didn't mean for everyone to... the fire just...' (rest is burnt away)
Letter 4: 'They took Scratcher away. I'm alone here. I need to escape. The vent under the desk - I think I can fit through. If only I had a tool...' (unfinished)

items.name: Cell Key
items.description: An old iron key that unlocks Annie's cell door. Found hanging on a hook beyond the vent.

items.name: Screwdriver
items.description: A rusty screwdriver found in the janitor's jacket pocket. Can be used to unscrew the vent grate.

puzzles.name: Piece Together Annie's Story
puzzles.description: Discover the truth about Annie, Scratcher, and the tragic fire by finding and examining all clues in the room.
clues: Read all of Annie's letters to understand her relationship with Scratcher.
Examine the teddy bear to discover its demonic nature.
Find the drawing under the mattress.
Inspect the charred wall to read her ash writings.
Notice the claw marks throughout the room.
puzzles.reward: Once you piece together the full story, you understand that the vent is the escape route.

puzzles.name: Escape Through the Vent
puzzles.description: Find a way to open the vent underneath the desk and crawl through to freedom.
clues: The vent is screwed shut - you need a tool.
Annie mentions in her letters that she needed a tool to escape.
Perhaps items from other rooms can help (like the janitor's closet).
puzzles.reward: You crawl through the vent and find the cell key on the other side, allowing you to unlock the door for other players.

winCondition.description: Solve Annie's story puzzle and escape through the vent to get the cell key
requirements: Find the screwdriver (from Bathroom/Janitor's Closet - Room 2)
Crawl through vent to get cell key

atmosphere.soundscape: Creaking metal, distant whispers, faint crying, wind through the vent
atmosphere.visualTheme: Charred walls, dim lighting, cold metal, worn wood, ash residue
atmosphere.emotionalTone: Players should feel empathy for Annie's tragedy while being unsettled by Scratcher's demonic presence
